classification.description: REVEALS_NEW_PROPERTY: reveals a new dimension, property, or condition. REVEALS_VARIATION: shows a variation of the same pattern. REVEALS_COUNTERPATTERN: shows an opposing pattern that complexifies the hypothesis. NO_NEW_INFORMATION: adds nothing new.

revealed_insight.description: A single sentence capturing WHAT the segments reveal about the phenomenon (not whether they confirm the hypothesis).

suggested_hypothesis_refinement.description: If REVEALS_NEW_PROPERTY or REVEALS_COUNTERPATTERN, suggest how to refine the hypothesis. Otherwise omit.

brief_rationale.description: One sentence justifying the classification, citing the key segment.

referenced_entities.description: Entities from the database that were referenced in this analysis. Populated by the orchestration layer for traceability.

segment_ids.description: Segment IDs referenced in this output.

code_ids.description: Category/code IDs referenced in this output.

hypothesis_ids.description: Hypothesis IDs referenced in this output.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs referenced in this output.

document_ids.description: Document IDs referenced in this output.
